columns.entityId: Entity identifier scoped to this dataset
columns.name: Display label
columns.value: Published quantity or explicit category; never impute null as zero
columns.period: Observation or study period, not retrieval date
columns.geographicId: ISO code or named source geography; null for abstract observations
columns.lat: Published latitude only; null when unsupported
columns.lon: Published longitude only; null when unsupported
columns.metric: Source-defined metric identifier; compare only within the same metric

denominator: All electrical/electronic equipment for the global mass series; small IT and telecom category mass for the 22% collection rate; cross-border aggregate for 5.1 million tonnes. Categories overlap and must not be added.

geography.anchorRule: Use an explicitly non-geographic sphere or global band. No national fill, fake city locations, or inferred unobserved distribution.

time.updateCadence: Frozen research snapshot; recheck source before any update, not a live feed

coverage.included: 7 populated records; inclusion is defined by the exact source locator in every row
coverage.omitted: AI/server-specific waste, bilateral shipment paths, illegal-shipment identities and destination-specific pollution.
coverage.missingness: Unobserved or unpublished is not zero; omitted places/classes have no inferred values.

uncertainty: Rounded estimates. Documented formal collection is not all material recovery. No assumption that unrecorded waste was dumped; no country or region allocation is supported.

transform.description: Transcribed selected published factual findings into a normalized long table; values retain source precision. No interpolation or score normalization.
transform.validation: Row-level source locators; numerical bounds and schema checked locally; independent review pending.

verification.method: Primary publication/table read and values transcribed, with comparison to source metadata; independent acceptance pending.

scoring.reason: No defensible common 1–100 extremity construct. Display source metric and uncertainty in original units.

forecast.reason: No original future extrapolation; any model evaluations are retrospective results only.
